-- test: raw endpoint basic access --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} raw /health
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.status == UP


-- test: raw endpoint non-existent --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} raw /nonexistent
-- expect:error --
"error":
-- expect:stdout --
"error":
-- expect:stdout --
not exposed by this application
-- expect:stderr --
not exposed by this application


-- test: raw excluded endpoint gets activation guidance --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} raw mappings
-- expect:error --
not exposed by this application
-- expect:stdout --
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include


-- test: raw endpoint without slash prefix --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} raw health
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.status == UP


-- test: raw multi-pod --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod[0]}} --pod {{pod[1]}} raw /health
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data.status == UP
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.1.data.status == UP
